monthly_income_rule_last_cycle_check.name: monthly_income_rule_last_cycle_check
monthly_income_rule_last_cycle_check.value: last_expected_cycle is null or (last_expected_cycle ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' and last_expected_cycle >= first_expected_cycle)

onboarding_snapshot_confirmed_fields_che.name: onboarding_snapshot_confirmed_fields_check
onboarding_snapshot_confirmed_fields_che.value: "fintrack"."onboarding_snapshot"."status" = 'DRAFT' or ("fintrack"."onboarding_snapshot"."cutover_at" is not null and "fintrack"."onboarding_snapshot"."confirmed_at" is not null)

recurring_expense_rule_last_cycle_check.name: recurring_expense_rule_last_cycle_check
recurring_expense_rule_last_cycle_check.value: last_cycle is null or (last_cycle ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' and last_cycle >= first_cycle)
